# Yassine El Ouazzani

> Full-Stack & Mobile Developer specializing in native Android, Flutter, and scalable web platforms.

## About
Yassine El Ouazzani is a software developer focused on building secure mobile applications and full-stack web platforms. He holds a Specialized Degree in Digital Development (Mobile Applications) from OFPPT - ISTAG Bab Tizimi.

## Core Technical Skills
- Mobile Development: Kotlin, Flutter, Dart, Android SDK
- Frontend Engineering: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3
- Backend & Systems: Go, Python, Flask, Node.js, REST APIs
- Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase
- DevOps & Tools: Linux, Docker, Git

## Featured Projects
- [mehro-paste](https://paste.mehro.me): Fast, zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted paste sharing with burn-on-read. Built with Next.js, Libsodium WASM, and Redis.
- [Sentinel](https://github.com/Yass5002/sentinel): Dead Man's Switch platform with a Go API backend and Flutter mobile client featuring real-time GPS tracking and encrypted alert delivery.
- [ORA](https://github.com/Yass5002/Ora): Open-source Android countdown app with Material You design and home screen widgets.
- [Moroccan Educational System](https://github.com/Yass5002/moroccan-educational-system): Standardized JSON dataset of the Moroccan national curriculum and continuous assessments.
- [Laboratoire AL AMAL](https://github.com/Yass5002/alamal): Trilingual production website for an accredited medical analysis laboratory in Meknes.
